Class MicronautCliConfig

java.lang.Object
io.micronaut.projectgen.micronaut.features.cli.MicronautCliConfig
public class MicronautCliConfig extends Object
Configuration class that represents the structure of the micronaut-cli.yml file. It holds metadata about the generated Micronaut project including the application type, test framework, source language, selected features, build tool, and the default package name.
